t.why: It produces close to 70% of the world's cobalt, which matters for the battery industry. In 2025 it signed a US-brokered peace deal with Rwanda.
t.rel: It has fought the M23 rebels in the east, said to be backed by Rwanda, and signed a US-brokered peace deal with Rwanda in 2025. Its wealth of minerals such as cobalt draws the attention of the great powers.
t.korea: Its cobalt, a battery material, links it to Korean industry.
t.know: The DRC produces more of the cobalt used in smartphones and electric-vehicle batteries than any other country.
t.etext: The world's biggest producer of cobalt for EV batteries, with plenty of copper too. Its underground wealth is among the greatest in the world, but long-running armed conflict in the east and corruption leave most people poor.
